epistemic_status: DESIGN ARTIFACT + TESTS. Defines behaviour at the boundaries. Establishes no effect.
scope: structural and identity assertions over existing artifacts only. Nothing is fitted, tuned, scored or compared to any outcome. No arm performance is read.
postgame_use_declaration: realised box membership is used ONLY to audit the pregame universe's own counters, per PREDICTION_CONTRACT_V5_SPEC section 6. No candidate is created from it.
